input.code:
def process(fraud_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = fraud_reports.copy()
    df.columns = ['Rank', 'State', 'Reports_per_100K', 'Total_Reports']
    df = df[df['State'].notna() & (df['State'] != '') & ~df['State'].str.contains('District of Columbia and Puerto Rico', na=False) & ~df['State'].str.contains('Source:', na=False)]
    df['Rank'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Rank'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Rank'].notna()]
    df['Reports_per_100K'] = df['Reports_per_100K'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['Total_Reports'] = df['Total_Reports'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['Type'] = 'Fraud_and_Other'
    return df[['State', 'Reports_per_100K', 'Type']]
